author: Jackson Weaver
description: Despite a major star's return to dramatic acting, a two-time best director winner at the Oscars and enough publicity to rival the moon landing, Digger looks set to become one of the biggest box-office disasters of the year.
title: Digger is poised to be one of the biggest box-office flops of the year

author: Griffin Jaeger
description: The Heated Rivalry star wore Indigenous designer Justin Jacob Louis's blue-and-black journey knit cardigan to an event in New York on Wednesday along with an orange ribbon on his chest marking National Day for Truth and Reconciliation.
title: Hudson Williams wore this cardigan. Then the Indigenous designer's business went viral

author: Muriel Draaisma
description: Twelve Jewish teachers have filed human rights complaints against a group of Ontario school boards and teachers' unions, alleging they have experienced discrimination at their workplaces due to incidents of antisemitism.
title: 12 Jewish teachers file human rights complaints against group of Ontario school boards, unions

author: Rhianna Schmunk
description: A 911 outage that lasted nearly an hour and a half in several Canadian provinces last month was caused by a previously undetected bug in Bell's software, the company said in a report on Friday.
title: Software issue knocked out 911 service for several provinces last month, Bell report says

author: Lauren Krugel
description: It's been a relatively quiet decade in Alberta's oilsands, but the federal and provincial governments believe a new West Coast pipeline coupled with policy shifts might help turn up the volume. Prime Minister Mark Carney and Alberta Premier Danielle Smith say that if oilsands companies start building again — as they hope — it will be different this time around.
title: Carney, Smith say new West Coast pipeline could get oil companies building again

author: David Cummings
description: Prime Minister Mark Carney's new national council on artificial intelligence is meant to provide the government with guidance on the evolution of its AI strategy and on making the technology safer.
title: Ottawa launches new national AI council to advise on safety, deployment

author: Brett Forester
description: Courts countrywide are grappling with the complex question of whether federal and provincial governments can be sued for the stark overrepresentation of Indigenous children in the off-reserve child welfare system, delivering dizzyingly mixed results.
title: Legal battles mount over the off-reserve Millennium Scoop

author: John Mazerolle
description: Brooke Eby, a U.S. woman who shared her diagnosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, or ALS, with honesty and humour, amassing millions of views on Instagram and TikTok, has died of the disease at 37.
title: Brooke Eby, TikToker who used wit and sincerity to educate people about her life with ALS, dead at 37

description: Hockey Canada president and chief executive officer Katherine Henderson was up for one of the minimum three female spots on the IIHF council at Friday's election, but was eliminated in the second of three rounds of voting in Tenerife, Spain. That means no Canadians have been elected to the council, a surprising result for a nation considered one of the sport's powerhouses.
title: No Canadians elected to world hockey governing body; Turkey, New Zealand represented

description: CBS Sports and Tony Romo have officially parted ways, one month after the former Dallas Cowboys quarterback pleaded no contest to charges of operating a vehicle while intoxicated.
title: CBS Sports describes Tony Romo's permanent exit as mutual parting
5 foreign nationals arrested in connection to B.C. extortions, shootings and arsons

author: Helen Surgenor
description: Gypsy Rose Blanchard, who spent more than seven years in prison for her mother's murder, is speaking out after Ken Urker, her former fiancé and the father of her daughter, died yesterday.
title: Gypsy Rose Blanchard speaks out about death of her ex-fiancé, Ken Urker
G7 nations agree to release 100 million barrels of oil, including diesel, amid energy crunch

author: Janyce McGregor
description: LNG Canada will once again use Chinese steel for the "specialized fabrication capability" it says it requires for its $33-billion Phase 2 expansion project in Kitimat, B.C.
title: LNG Canada to use Chinese steel on $33-billion expansion project in Kitimat, B.C.

description: The Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has recorded more than 4,000 deaths, authorities say, as they struggle to contain the spread of the virus.
title: Congo's Ebola outbreak surpasses 4,000 deaths amid violence and mistrust

description: CBC/Radio-Canada unveiled its broadcast schedule Friday for the upcoming Professional Women’s Hockey League season, which features more games on the network than ever before.
title: CBC/Radio-Canada reveals PWHL broadcast schedule, including return of Hockey Night in Canada

author: Anya Zoledziowski
description: Almog Italie and his family were on the final leg of their trip home following a vacation in Japan when they felt FlyDubai flight FZ1073 plummet. Italie was one of 174 people on board the plane earlier this week when one of the pilots stabbed the other in an attempt to crash the plane. The flight plunged 30,000 feet in under 30 seconds.
title: 'Prepared ourselves for the worst': FlyDubai passenger recounts moments during cockpit attack

author: Vincent McDermott
description: Political leaders in Alberta’s oilsands region say they hope the potential one million barrels of oil per day that could flow through a new West Coast oil pipeline will also bring jobs and economic spinoffs.
title: Mayors, First Nations chiefs in Alberta's oilsands region react tentatively to West Coast pipeline designation

author: Steve Douglas
description: Manchester City has lodged a "comprehensive" appeal, the club confirmed Friday, following the publication of a report by an independent commission detailing large-scale financial rule-breaking by the Premier League giant.
title: Man City lodges 'comprehensive' appeal after being found guilty of financial rule-breaking

author: Allison Jones
description: Ontario government officials who inspected three Academy of Learning career colleges found evidence suggesting third parties were completing the coursework and a few students who couldn't name their school or program, they alleged in reports filed in court.
title: Government inspection at 3 Ontario career colleges reported 'serious concerns,' court records show

description: About 400 schools in France are expected to remain closed on Friday after student protests over education
title: Violent protests in France over state of education lead to closure of nearly 400 schools
'I am Jane Doe': Online rally to protect Cornell rape accuser's identity becomes a reckoning
New York attorney general, governor outline next steps in Cornell rape allegations investigation

description: The Indian airline captain who helped thwart an apparent attempt to crash a FlyDubai flight described Friday how he fought for his life in the minutes after his co-pilot stabbed him and the plane began a steep descent.
title: 'I was fighting for my life': Indian pilot hailed as hero recalls FlyDubai cockpit attack

author: Ryan Cooke
description: Martin Marks has pleaded guilty to four dozen charges after being caught twice with copious amounts of fentanyl and cocaine.
title: 'Like an episode of Breaking Bad': Man caught in N.L.'s largest fentanyl bust pleads guilty

author: Mark Anderson
description: A'ja Wilson made sure her basketball spoke for itself Thursday night. The four-time WNBA MVP, who had a verbal encounter with a Fever fan in Indiana two nights earlier, scored 36 points and grabbed 10 rebounds to lead the defending champion Las Vegas Aces to a 94-83 victory in the deciding Game 3 of the first round.
title: A'ja Wilson, Aces send the Fever home again with a 94-83 win in Game 3
Hidden cameras show some stores unlocking speed limits on e-bikes, selling e-scooters that go up to 120 km/h

author: Alexandre Silberman
description: A Quebec train factory battered by years of layoffs is expanding as governments push to buy Canadian. Alstom's La Pocatière plant is hiring and scaling up for major domestic rail contracts, including a $4.7-billion VIA Rail project.
title: Amid the push to build Canadian, a Quebec train factory is booming

author: Yasmine Hassan
description: The UN World Food Program's cash-for-work program helps provide stable work and income for Palestinians in Gaza, who have with little to no other options.
title: In Gaza, a UN cash-for-work program gives Palestinians some income — and hope

author: Alex Boyd, Jeff Yates
description: The account Rise of Alberta is anonymous and drives four times as much engagement as the next most popular account.
title: It's the biggest Alberta separatist account on the internet. It has links to a movement leader

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: Several legal experts note there are some striking similarities between the alleged gang rape case unfolding at Cornell University this week and last year's Hockey Canada sexual assault trial in London, Ont., which saw all five players acquitted.
title: What Cornell's alleged rape case and the Hockey Canada trial's striking parallels reveal

author: Georgie Smyth
description: Prolonged drought in B.C.'s Southern Interior has led to explosive wildfires that current modelling software struggles to predict. It's partly because the data that informs these computer models was collected at least 30 years ago, when extreme fire behaviour, driven by events like prolonged drought — a feature of climate change — was less comm
title: Why are B.C. firefighters still using wildfire data from the 1990s?

author: Boshko Maric
description: Montreal Canadiens fans wanting to see their team play at home this season will have to pay a premium for tickets, with average prices at the Bell Centre higher than anywhere else across the NHL.
title: Why your Habs tickets cost more than any other NHL team's this season
